basic_profile.bio: I'm a 26-year-old who recently got into gaming, especially Destiny 2, after my college friends recommended it. I currently live in Panama City, where I work as a junior graphic designer. I'm still exploring what the city has to offer, and I love hitting the beach on weekends. I'm single, and I usually play games in the evenings after work, around 7 PM to midnight local time.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Most of my gaming knowledge comes from my friends and watching YouTube tutorials. I don't have a deep understanding of game mechanics yet, but I'm eager to learn. I occasionally browse Reddit threads to get tips and tricks.
